dvids.title: USS Spruance returns to San Diego following historic 12-month combat deployment
dvids.desc: SAN DIEGO — Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Spruance (DDG 111), with embarked Helicopter Maritime Strike Squadron (HSM) 71 Detachment, returned to its home port of Naval Base San Diego, concluding a 12-month deployment to the U.S. 3rd, 7th, and 5th Fleet areas of operations, Nov. 13

dvids.title: Readout of U.S. Naval Forces Central Command/U.S. 5th Fleet/Combined Maritime Forces Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw's Meeting with Israeli Navy Leadership
dvids.desc: HAIFA, Israel (Nov. 13, 2026) - U.S. Naval Forces Central Command/U.S. 5th Fleet/Combined Maritime Forces Commander Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw met with Israeli Navy key leaders during a trip to Haifa, Israel, Nov. 11.

dvids.title: George Washington Dental Team Boosts Readiness in U.S. 5th Fleet
dvids.desc: ARABIAN SEA (Nov. 13, 2026) — A dental tiger team from the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George Washington (CVN 73) embarked on six destroyers during its deployment, providing dental care to more than 600 Sailors – most recently the Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Shoup (DDG 86)
